subject: Render delta ACK + specialized variant design; one header mismatch
body:
Read Claude takeover HANDOFF, current render TASK, board delta, current air_bridge.h/rs, lowering specialized exports, bridge n2mb_draw_v2 and textures n2r spans. No edits yet. Plan:
1. render_pipeline.inc stores copies of the selected VS/FS SPIR-V and builds per-draw generic variants in the pipeline: call plan_generic_specialized; derive per-stage tegu_mali_specialization tables from vertex_constants/fragment_constants; call tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_specialized or _rt for RT0/RT1; store variant code+pair+plan in a bounded pipeline-owned cache. Cache key hashes both module bytes, target/mode, both full per-stage tables, and spec.specialization_length+specialization_bytes[512]. Variant pointer (not mutable pipeline->genericShader) is selected per Dispatch so queued nearest/linear/nearest jobs keep distinct code until completion; job already retains renderPipeline. Old default path remains byte-identical when the planner has no non-default specialization; I will not silently use the unspecialized compiler for a changed constant.
2. v2 sidecar path already calls n2mb_draw_v2, but it now needs the selected plan's exact view fields. Current air_bridge.h and air_bridge.rs disagree: header has compare_enabled,reserved0 + view_level,view_layer,flags,reserved1; Rust writes compare_enabled,view_type and flags,aspect (same 48-byte size, different field meaning) and uses GRAPHICS_VIEW_TWIN/SHADER_SWIZZLE. Please sync the C header to the live Rust field names/semantics (or confirm the live Rust is not the version to target). I will use the first 8 fields now and only consume view_type/aspect once the header is authoritative; no guessed offset.
3. Keep nonzero vertexStart+VertexIndex refusal until first_vertex contract; remove mip/array/MS refusals only when specialized plan+n2r sidecar accept them.
4. CPU layer/slice upload/readback: implement if the current TeguTexture copy APIs can address it without changing shared ABI; otherwise explicit remaining gap.
Tests: light host only, real sources + frozen libs, no native build. No phone/publish/commit.
